name: model-dispatch-advisor
description: Query shared model/harness quota snapshots and manage soft user selection preferences across equivalent functional candidate groups.

interface.shortDescription: Same-function model/harness quota & user selection preferences

customGroups.title: Custom functional groups (JSON)
customGroups.description: Optional JSON map of custom functional groups and candidate definitions.

zh.title: 自定义功能组（JSON）
zh.description: 可选的自定义同功能组与候选定义 JSON。

tools.name: dispatch_advisor_recommend
tools.description: Read shared model/harness quota snapshots, active user selection preferences, and ranked same-function dispatch candidates. Returns soft recommendations with quota status, user preference provenance, and concise reasons without mutating profiles, global config, or active dispatches.

group.description: Functional group to evaluate (e.g. "implementation", "frontend", "review", "research", "writing", "thinking", "director", or a custom group). Defaults to "implementation".

role.description: Optional target agent role/profile (e.g. "implementer", "writer", "think", "director"). Protected roles (writer, think, director) keep their role default unless an explicit user-authorized preference targets that role/group or explicitTarget is set.

explicitTarget.description: Model ID, candidate ID, profile, or harness explicitly named by the user for this turn. Explicit user selection outranks soft preferences while still respecting hard profile constraints.

id.description: Stable candidate identifier inside the functional group.

profile.description: Optional subagent profile name (e.g. implementer, implementer-grokbuild, implementer-argon).

executorId.description: External harness engine ID when kind is external-harness (e.g. grok-acp, agy-cli, codex-app-server).

modelId.description: Configured Kiki model alias/ID or native harness model ID.

family.description: Model family tag such as gpt, grok, gemini, claude, kimi, deepseek.

defaultRank.description: Baseline priority within the functional group (lower is earlier).

isRoleDefault.description: True when this candidate represents the role default when no explicit preference applies.

allowedModels.description: Optional hard model allowlist from the target profile; hard constraints are never overridden by soft preferences.

deniedModels.description: Optional hard model denylist from the target profile or caller.

candidates.description: Optional explicit candidate list (including external harnesses/profiles) to merge or evaluate for this group.

constraints.description: Optional hard profile/caller admission constraints (allowedModels, deniedModels, allowedProfiles, deniedProfiles).

includeAllGroups.description: When true, also include a compact summary of saved preferences across all functional groups.

tools.name: dispatch_preference_update
tools.description: Save, inspect, or clear user-stated model/harness selection preferences and custom functional groups in this plugin’s own data store. Recording a preference requires explicit user authorization (userAuthorized=true and userQuote/sourceNote); model-inferred guesses are rejected.

action.description: set saves/replaces a functional group preference; clear removes one group or all preferences; get reads stored state; define_group/remove_group manages custom functional groups and candidates.

group.description: Functional group ID (e.g. "implementation"). Required for set, define_group, remove_group, and single-group clear.

clearAll.description: When action="clear" and clearAll=true, removes all stored preferences (and custom groups if includeCustomGroups=true).

includeCustomGroups.description: When action="clear" and clearAll=true, also clear custom group definitions.

prefer.description: Candidate IDs, families (e.g. "grok", "gemini"), profiles (e.g. "implementer-grokbuild", "implementer-argon"), or model IDs to prioritize inside this group.

avoid.description: Candidate IDs, families (e.g. "gpt"), profiles, or model IDs to deprioritize softly (use less) inside this group.

authorizedRoles.description: Explicit roles (such as "writer", "think", "director") the user explicitly authorized changing. Omit for general implementation preferences.

userAuthorized.description: Must be true when saving a preference: confirms the preference comes from an explicit user instruction rather than agent self-inference.

userQuote.description: Concise verbatim user instruction or summary of what the user stated (e.g. "现在 GPT 少用一点，实现优先用 Grok Build 或其他非 GPT").

sourceNote.description: Provenance anchor such as turn/session note or operator entry.

protectedRoleDefault.description: When action="define_group", marks whether this group protects its role default unless explicitly authorized.

id.description: Stable candidate identifier inside the functional group.

profile.description: Optional subagent profile name (e.g. implementer, implementer-grokbuild, implementer-argon).

executorId.description: External harness engine ID when kind is external-harness (e.g. grok-acp, agy-cli, codex-app-server).

modelId.description: Configured Kiki model alias/ID or native harness model ID.

family.description: Model family tag such as gpt, grok, gemini, claude, kimi, deepseek.

defaultRank.description: Baseline priority within the functional group (lower is earlier).

isRoleDefault.description: True when this candidate represents the role default when no explicit preference applies.

allowedModels.description: Optional hard model allowlist from the target profile; hard constraints are never overridden by soft preferences.

deniedModels.description: Optional hard model denylist from the target profile or caller.

candidates.description: Custom candidates for action="define_group" (or optional group candidate overrides).
